mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_address_book WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} ORDER BY IS_DEFAULT DESC, REGIST_DT DESC
SELECT * FROM tb_address_book WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND IS_DEFAULT = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_address_book ( USER_NO, ADDRESS_NAME, RECIPIENT_NAME, RECIPIENT_PHONE, ZIP_CODE, ADDRESS_MAIN, ADDRESS_DETAIL, IS_DEFAULT, MEMO, REGIST_DT, UPDT_DT ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{addressName}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{zipCode}, #{addressMain}, #{addressDetail}, #{isDefault}, #{memo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_address_book SET ADDRESS_NAME = #{addressName}, RECIPIENT_NAME = #{recipientName}, RECIPIENT_PHONE = #{recipientPhone}, ZIP_CODE = #{zipCode}, ADDRESS_MAIN = #{addressMain}, ADDRESS_DETAIL = #{addressDetail}, IS_DEFAULT = #{isDefault}, MEMO = #{memo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE ADDRESS_ID = #{addressId} AND USER_NO = #{userNo}
